metadata.hfGraphModeDescription: Showing trace-backed flow. Residual edges and tensor flow are expected to be explicit.

nodeAttributes.name: layer_type
nodeAttributes.description: Decoder layer type from the model config's layer_types list.

nodeAttributes.name: Stage
nodeAttributes.description: One-based ResNet encoder stage index for a bottleneck group.

nodeAttributes.name: Blocks
nodeAttributes.description: Number of repeated bottleneck blocks in this ResNet encoder stage.

nodeAttributes.name: Channels
nodeAttributes.description: Output channel width for this ResNet encoder stage.

nodeAttributes.name: Attention
nodeAttributes.description: Attention mode for this decoder layer. Sliding attention uses a local token window; full attention can attend across the full context.

nodeAttributes.name: Window
nodeAttributes.description: Sliding-attention window size in tokens. Full-attention layers do not use a local window.

nodeAttributes.name: Attention pattern
nodeAttributes.description: Repeating attention cycle, for example 4+1 means four sliding-attention layers followed by one full-attention layer.

nodeAttributes.name: Cycle repeat
nodeAttributes.description: How many times the shown decoder-cycle motif repeats in the model.

nodeAttributes.name: Hidden
nodeAttributes.description: Transformer hidden-state width: the token representation size carried between sublayers.

nodeAttributes.name: FFN intermediate
nodeAttributes.description: Dense feed-forward/MLP intermediate width inside the block.

nodeAttributes.name: State size
nodeAttributes.description: State-space dimension used by Mamba-style recurrent state updates.

nodeAttributes.name: Conv kernel
nodeAttributes.description: Depthwise causal convolution kernel width used inside a Mamba mixer.

nodeAttributes.name: Time-step rank
nodeAttributes.description: Low-rank time-step projection width used to parameterize Mamba discretization.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Falcon-Mamba source-level operation represented by this node.

nodeAttributes.name: Implementation
nodeAttributes.description: Module, parameter, or function used by the Falcon-Mamba implementation.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Bailing-MoE-V2 source-level operation represented by this node.

nodeAttributes.name: Implementation
nodeAttributes.description: Module, parameter, or function used by the Bailing-MoE-V2 implementation.

nodeAttributes.name: Expert intermediate
nodeAttributes.description: Intermediate width inside each routed MoE expert feed-forward network.

nodeAttributes.name: Heads
nodeAttributes.description: Number of query/attention heads.

nodeAttributes.name: Patch size
nodeAttributes.description: Vision patch size in pixels for the image encoder input stem.

nodeAttributes.name: KV heads
nodeAttributes.description: Number of key-value heads. Equal to attention heads in classic multi-head attention; smaller in grouped-query or multi-query attention.

nodeAttributes.name: Input hidden
nodeAttributes.description: Input hidden-state width before a projection or modality bridge.

nodeAttributes.name: Output tokens
nodeAttributes.description: Number of tokens produced by a tokenizer, projector, or pooling bridge.

nodeAttributes.name: Head dim
nodeAttributes.description: Per-head vector dimension used by attention.

nodeAttributes.name: Layers
nodeAttributes.description: Number of transformer decoder layers in the model.

nodeAttributes.name: Context
nodeAttributes.description: Maximum context length in tokens from the model config.

nodeAttributes.name: Pooling
nodeAttributes.description: Pooling strategy used by a sequence-classification head.

nodeAttributes.name: Labels
nodeAttributes.description: Number of output labels/classes in a classification head.

nodeAttributes.name: Label names
nodeAttributes.description: Output label names from the model config.

nodeAttributes.name: Problem type
nodeAttributes.description: Training/inference problem type from the model config, for example multi-label classification.

nodeAttributes.name: Experts
nodeAttributes.description: Total number of routed experts available in the MoE block.

nodeAttributes.name: Active experts
nodeAttributes.description: Number of experts selected for each token in the MoE block.

nodeAttributes.name: Shared experts
nodeAttributes.description: Number of dense shared experts added alongside routed experts in the MoE block.

nodeAttributes.name: Router groups
nodeAttributes.description: Number of expert groups used by grouped top-k MoE routing.

nodeAttributes.name: Top-k groups
nodeAttributes.description: Number of expert groups kept before selecting the per-token experts.

nodeAttributes.name: Source
nodeAttributes.description: Official Nemotron-Omni repo source file used to build this visualization.

nodeAttributes.name: Source class
nodeAttributes.description: Class name in the Nemotron-Omni implementation represented by this node or collapsed structure.

nodeAttributes.name: Mixer
nodeAttributes.description: Mixer type selected by the NemotronH hybrid decoder schedule for this block.

nodeAttributes.name: Layer schedule
nodeAttributes.description: Compact M/E/A schedule for the NemotronH decoder stack: M=Mamba, E=MoE, A=Attention.

nodeAttributes.name: Source
nodeAttributes.description: Official DeepSeek source file used to build this visualization.

nodeAttributes.name: Source class
nodeAttributes.description: Class name in DeepSeek's official inference/model.py represented by this node or collapsed structure.

nodeAttributes.name: Multiplicity
nodeAttributes.description: How many repeated source modules this DeepSeek collapsed structure represents.

nodeAttributes.name: Source
nodeAttributes.description: Official Kimi source files used to build this visualization.

nodeAttributes.name: Source class
nodeAttributes.description: Class name in Kimi's official modeling_kimi_k25.py/modeling_deepseek.py represented by this node or collapsed structure.

nodeAttributes.name: Multiplicity
nodeAttributes.description: How many repeated source modules this Kimi collapsed structure represents.

nodeAttributes.name: Source
nodeAttributes.description: Official LLaDA source files used to build this visualization.

nodeAttributes.name: Source class
nodeAttributes.description: Class name in LLaDA's official configuration_llada.py/modeling_llada.py represented by this node or collapsed structure.

nodeAttributes.name: Multiplicity
nodeAttributes.description: How many repeated source modules this LLaDA collapsed structure represents.

nodeAttributes.name: Mask token
nodeAttributes.description: Token id used as the diffusion mask token for masked denoising.

nodeAttributes.name: Vocab size
nodeAttributes.description: Vocabulary size: number of token IDs the embedding/output layers support.

nodeAttributes.name: Mel bins
nodeAttributes.description: Number of log-mel frequency bins consumed by an audio encoder.

nodeAttributes.name: Audio frames
nodeAttributes.description: Number of spectrogram frames consumed by the audio encoder input.

nodeAttributes.name: Out features
nodeAttributes.description: Output feature width of a linear head or projection.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Exact CLIP forward-pass expression represented by this semantic node.

nodeAttributes.name: Implementation
nodeAttributes.description: Function, parameter, or torch operation used by the CLIP implementation.

nodeAttributes.name: Output
nodeAttributes.description: Named value returned or passed onward by the CLIP forward pass.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Exact OwlV2 forward-pass expression represented by this semantic node.

nodeAttributes.name: Implementation
nodeAttributes.description: Function, module, or torch operation used by the OwlV2 implementation.

nodeAttributes.name: Output
nodeAttributes.description: Named value returned or passed onward by the OwlV2 object-detection forward pass.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Exact ModernBERT forward-pass expression represented by this semantic node.

nodeAttributes.name: Implementation
nodeAttributes.description: Function, module, or torch operation used by the ModernBERT implementation.

nodeAttributes.name: Output
nodeAttributes.description: Named value returned or passed onward by the ModernBERT forward pass.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Exact XLM-RoBERTa forward-pass expression represented by this semantic node.

nodeAttributes.name: Implementation
nodeAttributes.description: Function, module, or torch operation used by the XLM-RoBERTa implementation.

nodeAttributes.name: Output
nodeAttributes.description: Named value returned or passed onward by the XLM-RoBERTa forward pass.

nodeAttributes.name: Function
nodeAttributes.description: BGE-M3 retrieval functionality represented by this head.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Exact BGE-M3 source-level expression represented by this semantic node.

nodeAttributes.name: Implementation
nodeAttributes.description: Function, module, or checkpoint head used by the FlagEmbedding BGE-M3 implementation.

nodeAttributes.name: Output
nodeAttributes.description: Named value returned or passed onward by the BGE-M3 forward/encode path.

nodeAttributes.name: Outputs
nodeAttributes.description: BGE-M3 output set represented by a merged output node.

nodeAttributes.name: Source
nodeAttributes.description: Official Whisper source file used to build this visualization.

nodeAttributes.name: Source class
nodeAttributes.description: Class name in Transformers' Whisper implementation represented by this node or collapsed structure.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Source/config-backed operation represented by this Whisper semantic node.

nodeAttributes.name: Fusion inputs
nodeAttributes.description: Modalities merged into the decoder input stream by a multimodal fusion node.

nodeAttributes.name: Input channels
nodeAttributes.description: Conv2d input channel count from the traced torch.nn.Conv2d module.

nodeAttributes.name: Output channels
nodeAttributes.description: Conv2d output channel count from the traced torch.nn.Conv2d module.

nodeAttributes.name: Kernel size
nodeAttributes.description: Conv2d kernel size from the traced torch.nn.Conv2d module.

nodeAttributes.name: Stride
nodeAttributes.description: Conv2d stride from the traced torch.nn.Conv2d module.

nodeAttributes.name: Groups
nodeAttributes.description: Conv2d groups value from the traced torch.nn.Conv2d module.

nodeAttributes.name: Chunk
nodeAttributes.description: Number of continuous action steps predicted by the Pi05 flow-matching head.

nodeAttributes.name: Act dim
nodeAttributes.description: Padded continuous action-vector width used by the Pi05 policy.

nodeAttributes.name: Denoise steps
nodeAttributes.description: Number of flow-matching denoising steps used by Pi05 inference.

nodeAttributes.name: Style dim
nodeAttributes.description: Kokoro voice/style conditioning vector width from the checkpoint config.

nodeAttributes.name: Mel bins
nodeAttributes.description: Number of mel-frequency bins used by the Kokoro acoustic representation.

nodeAttributes.name: Max duration
nodeAttributes.description: Maximum per-token duration bucket count used by Kokoro's duration projection.

nodeAttributes.name: Kernel
nodeAttributes.description: Kokoro text encoder convolution kernel size from the checkpoint config.

nodeAttributes.name: Upsample rates
nodeAttributes.description: iSTFTNet generator upsampling rates from the Kokoro config.

nodeAttributes.name: iSTFT
nodeAttributes.description: iSTFT window/hop settings used by the Kokoro waveform generator.

nodeAttributes.name: Sample rate
nodeAttributes.description: Kokoro waveform sample rate in Hz.

nodeAttributes.name: Component
nodeAttributes.description: Diffusers pipeline component represented by this Z-Image node.

nodeAttributes.name: Operation
nodeAttributes.description: Source/config-backed operation represented by this Z-Image semantic node.

nodeAttributes.name: DiT forwards
nodeAttributes.description: Number of transformer denoising forwards used by the Z-Image Turbo pipeline.

nodeAttributes.name: Latent channels
nodeAttributes.description: Latent channel count consumed by the Z-Image transformer and VAE.
